assignments.description: Element to assign value from the Formula Variable ValuetobepopulatedforNetSalesPrice to Net Sales Price Field in Opportunity Object
assignments.name: Assign_Value_to_Net_Sales_Price
assignments.label: Assign Value to Net Sales Price

Flow.description: Populate the Net Sales Price ( Amount ) field with Number of Assets x Average Value Per Asset when Lead Source = Dealer-Stockbook , Dealer-Wagonex and Number of Assets or Average Value Per Asset has changed.

formulas.description: Formula Variable to store the Product of two fields Number of Assets and Average Value per Asset
formulas.name: ValuetobepopulatedforNetSalesPrice

Flow.interviewLabel: Update Net Sales Price Field On Opportunity {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: Update Net Sales Price Field On Opportunity Create/Update

start.filterFormula:
AND( OR( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource}, 'Dealer-Stockbook'), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource}, 'Dealer-Wagonex') ), OR( ISCHANGED({!$Record.Number_of_Assets__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Average_Value_Per_Asset__c}), AND(ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Number_of_Assets__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Average_Value_Per_Asset__c}))
) ) )
